notes_for_editor: The FFLA list has two Moscow sites in Polk County, both marked Tower Gone: Loc 1 at 30.93584, -94.91582 and Loc 2 at 30.90192, -94.91568. The 1949 NGS description (Moscow Lookout Tower 17) gives no coordinates, so it is not confirmed which Loc it describes; the record keeps Loc 2 as the brief has it, and the story now says the match is uncertain. No source found describes removal or the site today. A 1930 Forest Worker quote on the Texas list page mentions two steel towers (95 and 120 ft) for a Polk County protection unit but does not name the sites, so it is not used. Revised 2026-10-10: the story no longer says 'small house' (the NGS page does not say it) and rewords the quoted phrases.
